title: Concept: Markup assigned through panel.outerHTML = markup (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, panel.outerHTML = markup rewrites an element through the HTML parser. A value built from a query parameter, stored profile or API field therefore executes as markup in the page origin. Use textContent assignment for text, or sanitize the fragment before assigning it.
applicability: javascript browser code that renders composed strings; lexical scope.
risk: Script execution in the victim origin; MEDIUM severity.
